findings.description: This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects, including the customer-master spreadsheet uploaded to it, are not protected by an explicitly enforced encryption policy or customer-managed key configuration.
The financials bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Financial objects can therefore be stored without an explicitly enforced encryption configuration.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so encryption at rest is not explicitly enforced by the bucket configuration.
The data-science bucket lacks a server-side encryption configuration. Its data can be stored without an explicitly configured encryption-at-rest control.
